maria (runtime): ran a cross-card profile for the continuous-batching heuristic this morning. focused on A10/T4/L4/A100/H100, 8k and 32k context mixes. attaching the short summary and a failing case on H100.

maria (runtime): tl;dr: per-card max-token ceilings need different defaults. H100 is regressing p95 for short seqs due to kernel selection falling back to an unfavorable attention kernel when tokens-per-batch < 3k. A10/T4/L4 behave fine with current ceilings.

ashwin: can you paste the perf snippet? curious which kernel path is getting chosen.

maria (runtime): here are the key lines from the profiler run (H100):
```
2026-03-17 07:12:03 perf-run: model=redwood-7b, seq=64, batch_tokens=1800
kernel_selector -> chosen=fused_attn_v2 (fallback path: qkv-repack)
kernel_exec: avg_ms=1.9, tail_ms=12.6, mem_copy_ms=0.8
kv_cache: hit_ratio=0.86, fragments=0.24
queue_wait_ms: p95=18.2 (spike correlated with kernel switch)
```

maria (runtime): the problem appears when batch_tokens sits in the 1k-3k window: the selector prefers a fused kernel that has high setup overhead on H100 for small micro-batches. on A10/L4 it amortizes fine.

kai: interesting. iirc we have a kernel-cost model that uses sequence-length and batch-tokens to pick kernels. maybe the cost table is stale for H100 micro-benchmarks.

ashwin: yup. i ran microbenchmarks last week; the crossover point for fused_attn_v2 vs tiled_attn on H100 is ~3.8k tokens (for seq<=128). current heuristic threshold is 2k. that would explain it.

maria (runtime): proposal: bump H100 token-ceiling threshold to 4k for choosing fused_attn_v2 and add a short-circuit for batch_tokens < 1k to always prefer tiled_attn. also lower A10 threshold slightly (1.6k -> 1.4k) to reduce KV fragmentation in mixed-packing cases.

jordan (perf): agree with per-card thresholds. also we need a safety net: if kernel-switch causes p95 increase > 10% for a model over a 1-hour window, automatically revert to previous kernel choice for that model+card. capture revert events in rollout metrics.

kai: +1. additionally, for tenants with high KV eviction rates (eviction_ratio>0.2), we should reduce max_tokens_per_batch by 10% so KV fragments less and we avoid memory alloc churn. we've seen eviction spikes on T4 when packing aggressive short requests.

infra-bot: perf-run-2376543210 finished: aggregated metrics uploaded -> https://perf.internal/runs/2376543210 (auth required). summary: H100 p95 up 13% at baseline thresholds, tiled_attn path p95 baseline 9% lower.

maria (runtime): thanks infra-bot. action plan i propose: 
1) change heuristic table: H100 fused_attn threshold -> 4000 tokens; small-batch short-circuit -> tile kernel under 1000 tokens. A10 threshold -> 1400 tokens.
2) add KV-eviction reactive knob: if eviction_ratio>0.2 reduce max_tokens_per_batch by 10% for that queue for 15m.
3) run a staged canary: 5% of traffic on H100 for 2 hours, collect p50/p95, tokens/sec, kernel-switch-count, eviction_ratio.
4) if p95 delta > 7% revert automatically.

ashwin: sounds right. can we also log kernel-selector input features (seq_len, batch_tokens, model_size, quantized) as a short vector so we can run offline decision-tree audits?

maria (runtime): yes — will add a compact vector to selector telemetry (no raw inputs, only numeric features).

jordan (perf): staging metrics to monitor: p50, p95, p99, tokens/sec, kernel-switch-rate, evictions/min, mem-alloc-failures, queue-p99-wait. i want a dashboard tile and an alert rule for kernel-switch-rate spikes.

kai: one more note: for mixed-packing (multiple tenant shapes) we should bias toward smaller kernels to avoid one big batch forcing other tenants into high-latency paths. propose an interleaving penalty: when mixed tenants > 3, multiply fused_attn threshold by 1.25.

maria (runtime): good idea. i'll include a mixed-packing multiplier.

maria (runtime): i'll push a config PR with the threshold table and rollout runbook in ~30m and tag this thread. any objections?

ashwin: no objections. one nit: please include a short regression test that simulates seq=16/64/256 mixes on H100.

jordan (perf): include synthetic KV-heavy trace for T4 too.

maria (runtime): noted. PR sumbitted -> https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/5412 : will start canary after infra approves.

infra-bot: deploy-check: runtime-config-pr/5412 CI passed. canary scheduled at 2026-03-17T10:00:00Z

maria (runtime): thanks all. will post results in this thread after 2h canary run. :thumbsup:
